Road geometry model comparison

Split: connected_group. Test data only. Predictions are estimates; target units and coordinate CRS are unconfirmed. Random-row results can share road identifiers across partitions. Grouped results do not prove geographic independence.

Coefficient units differ; magnitudes are not feature importance or causal effects. Location plots use the first geometry vertex, not the segment centroid; colour is signed log(1 + |residual|), not linear residual magnitude. The histogram includes all test residuals.
